title: Finally 24H
description: This datapack makes a full day 24H instead of 20mins
body:
# Finally 24H

A simple datapack that makes one Minecraft day last 24 real hours instead of the default 20 minutes.

## What it does
- Slows the day/night cycle to match real life time
- Perfect for SMPs where you want immersive time progression
- No commands needed — just install and play

## How to install
1. Download the .zip file
2. Drop it into your world's `datapacks` folder
3. Run `/reload` in-game (or restart the world)
4. Done!

## Compatibility
- Tested on Minecraft Java 26.1.2
- Works in singleplayer and multiplayer
- No conflicts with other datapacks

## Author
Made by Nicky Overbuilt — check out my YouTube channel and my other Minecraft mods/datapacks on my Modrinth profile.
